title: Wgpu Renderer Note Canvas Parity
description: Implement the note-canvas componentScene surface in the wgpu renderer (framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs), which currently falls through to a placeholder. Port geometry/interaction logic from framework/renderer/react/components/note-canvas-host.tsx (block bounds/hit-testing, resize handles, screen<->world conversion, ink erasers, snap-to-grid, marquee selection) into a direct DrawList painter (render_note_canvas) following the render_canvas_2d/render_raster pattern, wired into SceneSurfaceState pointer handling. Verify against the `note` playground comparing wgpu vs react renderers.
